questions.stem: Given the inequality chain W < S ≤ Q < X < T, decide which conclusions follow. I: S < T. II: W < Q.
options: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows
questions.explanation: Exhaustive valid-order checking confirms: I is always true and II is always true.

questions.stem: Given the inequality chain R > U > T = P ≥ Q, decide which conclusions follow. I: U > P. II: R ≤ U.

questions.stem: Ritu walks 20 km north, then 16 km east, then 4 km south and finally 4 km west. What is her shortest distance from the starting point?

questions.stem: Compare x and y. Equation I: x² + 10x + 24 = 0. Equation II: y² + 5y + 4 = 0. Which option is always correct?

questions.stem: Compare x and y. Equation I: x² + 5x + 4 = 0. Equation II: y² + 10y + 24 = 0. Which option is always correct?

questions.stem: Compare x and y. Equation I: x² + 15x + 56 = 0. Equation II: y² + 7y + 12 = 0. Which option is always correct?

questions.stem: A can finish a task in 18 days and B in 27 days. In how many days can they finish it together?
